capabilities: compute 5e and Pathfinder 2e encounter budgets from party and creature lines in a code block
render encounter blocks with XP totals, difficulty bars, and count-adjustment buttons
suggest and fill stats for 329 built-in SRD 5.2.1 monsters
read creature CR or level from linked notes' frontmatter
write an initiative block that Quick Initiative turns into a tracker
extras: Works entirely offline with no accounts or network. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Pathfinder numbers come from GM Core under the ORC License and the plugin is not endorsed by Paizo; 5e material comes from SRD 5.2.1 under CC BY 4.0.
problem: GMs have to tally encounter XP budgets and difficulty by hand or in outside tools; Obsidian has no built-in way to size a fight from a note.

relations.evidence: Press Start fight and an initiative block appears under the encounter with everyone in it.
A linked note gives its CR from a cr field in its frontmatter, the way Fantasy Statblocks writes it

summary: Code-block encounter builder for D&D 5e and Pathfinder 2e that computes XP budgets and difficulty, then hands the fight to Quick Initiative.
